text.zh: 攀岩完你最喜欢做什么？
text.en: What do you like to do after climbing?

text.zh: 直接回家洗澡休息
text.en: Go home and rest

text.zh: 和搭子去吃个饭
text.en: Grab food with friends

text.zh: 必须喝一杯，不喝等于没爬
text.en: Must grab a drink — no drink no climb

text.zh: 你到岩馆后的第一件事？
text.en: First thing you do at the gym?

text.zh: 看训练计划，直奔目标线路
text.en: Check my plan, head to target route

text.zh: 先随便爬两条热身，看心情
text.en: Warm up casually, see how I feel

text.zh: 扫一眼今天谁在，打个招呼再说
text.en: See who's here, say hi first

text.zh: 三个月不能去岩馆，你最难受的是什么？
text.en: 3 months without climbing — what hurts most?

text.zh: 体能下降，好不容易练出来的指力要废了
text.en: Losing fitness — my hard-earned finger strength

text.zh: 少了一个让自己开心的地方
text.en: Missing a place that makes me happy

text.zh: 见不到那帮人了
text.en: Not seeing my climbing crew

text.zh: 你搭子flash了你磨了三周的线，你的真实反应？
text.en: Your partner flashes your 3-week project. Real reaction?

text.zh: 脸上说牛逼，胃里泛酸，回家路上复盘他每个动作
text.en: Say 'nice' while dying inside, replay every move on the drive home

text.zh: 真心佩服，顺便偷偷决定今天一定要完攀
text.en: Genuinely impressed, secretly vow to send it today

text.zh: 替他开心啊，关我什么事
text.en: Happy for them, has nothing to do with me

text.zh: 小红书上有人说自己「攀岩一个月稳定V4」，你的反应？
text.en: Someone posts 'V4 in my first month of climbing'. Reaction?

text.zh: 立刻点进去看他在哪个馆，然后默默比较
text.en: Click in to check their gym, silently compare

text.zh: 随便看看就划走了
text.en: Scroll past

text.zh: V4就V4呗，跟我有什么关系
text.en: V4 is V4, nothing to do with me

text.zh: 你搭子今天临时不来了，你？
text.en: Your partner bails last minute. You?

text.zh: 算了改天吧，一个人去没劲
text.en: Skip it, no fun going alone

text.zh: 犹豫一下还是去了，但少了点意思
text.en: Still go, but it's not the same

text.zh: 自己去，本来就是去练的
text.en: Go anyway, I'm there to train

text.zh: 岩馆里你最享受的时刻？
text.en: Your favorite moment at the gym?

text.zh: 和搭子一起试同一条线，互相加油
text.en: Working a route with friends, cheering each other

text.zh: 在墙上那种什么都不想的专注感
text.en: That pure focus on the wall, thinking of nothing else

text.zh: 完攀一条磨了很久的线，那种突破感
text.en: Sending a long-term project, that breakthrough feeling

text.zh: 你爬一条已经能轻松完攀的线，你觉得？
text.en: Climbing a route you can easily send. Thoughts?

text.zh: 很享受，流畅地爬完一条线的感觉本身就很爽
text.en: Love it — the flow of a smooth send is its own reward

text.zh: 偶尔可以，当放松
text.en: Okay sometimes, as active rest

text.zh: 浪费时间，应该去试更难的
text.en: Waste of time, should be trying harder stuff

text.zh: 你更喜欢哪种session？
text.en: Your ideal session?

text.zh: 一个人慢慢爬，享受在墙上的感觉
text.en: Solo, savoring the movement

text.zh: 和朋友一起随便爬爬聊聊天
text.en: Casual session with friends

text.zh: 目标明确，今天就是要拿下那条线
text.en: Laser focused — today I send that route

text.zh: 旁边有人用特别离谱的方式爬一条简单线，你？
text.en: Someone climbs an easy route in a bizarre way. You?

text.zh: 忍不住走过去说「你可以试试这样」
text.en: Can't resist: 'Hey, maybe try it like this...'

text.zh: 内心吐槽完一整段但脸上微笑
text.en: Full internal roast, smiling on the outside

text.zh: 根本没注意到
text.en: Didn't even notice

text.zh: 搭子连续掉了五次同一个地方，你？
text.en: Your partner falls at the same spot 5 times. You?

text.zh: 开始详细讲解，恨不得替他上墙
text.en: Launch into a detailed breakdown, almost climb it for them

text.zh: 心里想「他今天是完攀不了的」但不说
text.en: Think 'not happening today' but keep quiet

text.zh: 说一句「加油」然后看手机
text.en: Say 'you got this' and check my phone

text.zh: 岩馆里很多人在看你爬，你？
text.en: Lots of people watching you climb. You?

text.zh: 肾上腺素拉满，动作都变好了
text.en: Adrenaline kicks in, I climb even better

text.zh: 稍微紧张但还好
text.en: Bit nervous but manageable

text.zh: 想换一面没人的墙
text.en: Want to move to an empty wall

text.zh: 你发攀岩相关的朋友圈/小红书吗？
text.en: Do you post climbing content on social media?

text.zh: 发，而且会认真选角度、选滤镜、编文案
text.en: Yes — carefully curated angles, filters, captions

text.zh: 偶尔发，随手拍就行
text.en: Sometimes, just a quick snap

text.zh: 不发，爬完就走
text.en: Never, climb and leave

text.zh: 你在岩馆爬得特别差的一天，你？
text.en: A really bad day at the gym. You?

text.zh: 提前走了，不想让别人看到
text.en: Leave early, don't want anyone to see

text.zh: 待到原定时间，但换去人少的区域
text.en: Stay but move to a quiet area

text.zh: 没什么，明天继续
text.en: Whatever, there's always tomorrow

text.zh: 有人主动来跟你搭话聊攀岩，你？
text.en: Someone comes up to chat about climbing. You?

text.zh: 内心希望他赶紧走，我想一个人练
text.en: Wishing they'd leave so I can train in peace

text.zh: 礼貌回应但不太主动
text.en: Polite but not really engaging

text.zh: 挺开心，聊呗
text.en: Cool, let's chat

text.zh: 连续三次掉在同一个地方，你脑子里的第一个想法？
text.en: Fall at the same spot 3 times. First thought?

text.zh: 今天状态不好 / 手皮薄了 / 鞋不对
text.en: Bad day / skin is thin / wrong shoes

text.zh: 可能某个环节没做对
text.en: Probably doing something wrong

text.zh: 我就是还不够强
text.en: I'm just not strong enough yet

text.zh: 你去了一个定级宽松的新馆，突然爬得特别好，你？
text.en: You crush at a soft-grading gym. Thoughts?

text.zh: 这才是我的真实水平
text.en: THIS is my real level

text.zh: 偷偷开心但知道是馆的原因
text.en: Secretly happy but I know it's the grading

text.zh: 换个馆就变强了？别骗自己
text.en: Different gym = stronger? Don't kid yourself

text.zh: 一个比你强的人给了你beta建议，但你自己的方法也行得通，你？
text.en: A stronger climber suggests beta, but your method works too. You?

text.zh: 直接用他的，人家比我强肯定有道理
text.en: Use theirs — they're better so they must be right

text.zh: 两个都试试看哪个好
text.en: Try both and see

text.zh: 谢了，但我有自己的方法
text.en: Thanks, but I'll stick with mine

text.zh: 选攀岩鞋的时候，你？
text.en: When choosing climbing shoes, you?

text.zh: 看大佬/教练推荐什么就买什么
text.en: Buy whatever the pros recommend

text.zh: 看测评对比一下再决定
text.en: Read reviews and compare

text.zh: 自己去店里试，脚知道答案
text.en: Try them on — my feet decide

text.zh: 你准备试一条很难的线，开爬前你会说什么？
text.en: About to try a hard route. What do you say?

text.zh: 「我肯定掉，你们看好了哈哈」
text.en: 'I'm definitely falling, watch this disaster haha'

text.zh: 「我试试看吧」
text.en: 'Let me give it a shot'

text.zh: 什么也不说直接上
text.en: Say nothing, just start

text.zh: 你完攀了一条对你来说很难的线，旁边有人鼓掌，你？
text.en: You send a hard route and people clap. You?

text.zh: 「哈哈运气好运气好，下次肯定掉」
text.en: 'Haha just lucky, definitely falling next time'

text.zh: 开心地说谢谢
text.en: Happily say thanks

text.zh: 点个头，默默去试下一条
text.en: Nod and quietly move to the next route

text.zh: 你觉得一个好岩馆最重要的是什么？
text.en: What matters most in a good climbing gym?

text.zh: 线路质量好，更新快
text.en: Good routes, frequent resets

text.zh: 离家近，去着方便
text.en: Close to home, convenient

text.zh: 氛围好，常客好看，容易认识新朋友
text.en: Great vibe, attractive regulars, easy to meet people
